description: This file defines the OptionsProviderInterface interface in the Drupal core, specifying methods for retrieving possible and settable values and options, with optional filtering by user account.

classes.name: OptionsProviderInterface
classes.description: Interface for retrieving all possible and settable values, used for defining options in data widgets and filtering data based on user permissions.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Returns an array of all possible values, optionally filtered by user account.

methods.name: getPossibleOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of possible options with labels, optionally filtered by user account.

methods.name: getSettableValues
methods.description: Returns an array of values that can be set, optionally filtered by user account.

methods.name: getSettableOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of settable options with labels, optionally filtered by user account.
